# Trophy

> > Trophy is a gamification platform that helps apps and platforms build engagement through streaks, achievements, leaderboards, and XP systems.

Trophy provides pre-built APIs and design guidance for implementing gamification mechanics across EdTech, fitness, B2B, and consumer apps. The site features case studies, implementation guides, and insights from the Levels Podcast on user retention and habit formation strategies.

## Key Topics

- gamification
- user-retention
- user-engagement
- streaks
- achievements
- leaderboards
- habit-formation
- points-and-levels
- product-design
- community-building
- user-motivation
- Trophy platform
- Duolingo
- Strava
- fitness apps

## Core Product & Solutions

- [Gamification Software For EdTech - Trophy](https://trophy.so/solutions/ed-tech): Trophy's EdTech solution: pre-built APIs for streaks, achievements, leaderboards

## Implementation Guides

- [How to Design Gamification That Actually Retains Users - Trophy](https://trophy.so/blog/how-to-design-gamification-that-actually-retains-users): Sylvi AI's approach to designing retention-focused gamification for B2C apps
- [How to Build Gamification Part 2: Establishing a Habit - Trophy](https://trophy.so/blog/2-establishing-a-habit): Series part 2: building core value loops for habit formation in new users
- [Your First Week Implementing Gamification with a Platform - Trophy](https://trophy.so/blog/first-week-implementing-gamification-platform): Week-by-week implementation guide for Trophy gamification platform setup
- [Gamification for Different User Segments - Trophy](https://trophy.so/blog/gamification-for-different-user-segments): Personalizing gamification strategies for different user motivation types
- [When Your App Needs an XP System - Trophy](https://trophy.so/blog/when-your-app-needs-xp-system): Guide to implementing XP systems: when they work and balancing earning rates
- [How B2B Platforms Use Gamification Without Looking Unprofessional - Trophy](https://trophy.so/blog/b2b-gamification-without-looking-unprofessional): Professional gamification design for B2B platforms like Salesforce & LinkedIn

## Gamification Case Studies

- [How Strava Uses Gamification to Improve Retention and Engagement - Trophy](https://trophy.so/blog/strava-gamification-case-study): Strava case study: segments, leaderboards, and social fitness gamification
- [How GitHub Leverages Gamification to Boost Retention (2025) - Trophy](https://trophy.so/blog/github-gamification-case-study): GitHub case study: contribution graphs, badges, and developer engagement
- [How MindTickle Leverages Gamification to Boost Retention (2025) - Trophy](https://trophy.so/blog/mindtickle-gamification-case-study): MindTickle case study: gamification in sales training and readiness platforms
- [Endomondo Case Study: The Impact of Gamification on Retention and Engagement (2025) - Trophy](https://trophy.so/blog/endomondo-gamification-case-study): Endomondo case study: fitness app gamification with points, badges, challenges
- [Yousician's Gamification Strategy: A Case Study (2025) - Trophy](https://trophy.so/blog/yousician-gamification-case-study): Yousician case study: gamification mechanics in music education platforms

- [What Happens When Users Lose Their Streaks - Trophy](https://trophy.so/blog/what-happens-when-users-lose-streaks): Psychology of streak loss and how apps can handle broken streaks effectively
- [Ritualizing Participation: How Shared Habits Build Stronger Communities - Trophy](https://trophy.so/blog/ritualizing-participation-how-shared-habits-build-stronger-communities): How shared rituals and participation patterns strengthen product communities
- [From Hearts to Energy: Why Coddy Switched Their Monetization Model - Trophy](https://trophy.so/blog/ab-testing-monetization-hearts-vs-energy): Coddy's A/B test results: energy system outperformed Duolingo-style hearts
- [How to Design Gamified Lifecycle Emails With Trophy - Trophy](https://trophy.so/blog/how-to-design-gamified-lifecycle-emails-with-trophy): Guide to designing engaging lifecycle email campaigns using Trophy

## Founder Insights & Product Stories

- [How Journable Plans to Add Gamification Without Sacrificing Simplicity - Trophy](https://trophy.so/blog/how-journable-adding-streaks-gamification-weight-loss-app): Case study: Journable's approach to adding streaks & badges to weight loss app
